name: The Greener Side
source:
Gabriel a human frustrated with his current life makes the decision to move to the magical world of Celt to see if he can find his calling in life.

His life journey will be accompanied by his friend Diarmuid, his two roommates Síofra and Niamh and a power that he isn't aware of yet.

[From [url=https://vanillabell.itch.io/the-greener-side]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加布里埃尔是一个对目前的生活感到沮丧的人类，他决定搬到凯尔特人的魔法世界，看看他是否能找到自己的人生使命。

他的人生旅程将由他的朋友迪尔穆德、他的两个室友西奥弗拉和尼亚姆以及一种他尚未意识到的力量陪伴。

[来自[url=https://vanillabell.itch.io/the-greener-side]Itch.io[/url]]
